_comment: The labelling node for this skills directory (bean 9umr; #980: nesting is described from within). Each topic is a subdirectory that HOLDS packages; a package keeps its own name, which is what skill_fetch takes. Read by scripts/skill-topics.ts, which descends only into the topics named here and refuses one that does not exist. Declare a topic only once it holds a package.

topics.title: Knowledge graph
topics.description: How the graph is declared, placed, read, restructured, exported and audited.

topics.title: Library and information management
topics.description: How sources are acquired, ingested, archived, catalogued and described.

topics.title: Rendering, UI and publication surfaces
topics.description: How the corpus is rendered, published and presented: the docs site, viewers, boards, themes, and their QC.

topics.title: Agent conduct
topics.description: How an agent behaves in the harness: interaction, confirmation, memory, security, and what it may and may not do on its own.

topics.title: Process model and execution
topics.description: How work is modelled and run: BPMN and DMN, roles and authorization, RACI, methodologies, and the workflow engine's state.
